semantics: build probe, not a site resolver: matches game code that embeds the hash constant 0x511454a9 (push imm32; push 0x511454a9; call). On 1.0.8.0 the probe HITS (VA 0xb3878c), so the fallback salt set is not applied; on other builds it misses and the ten substituted salts are written.
observation: each default .data value equals a 32-bit immediate embedded exactly once in the game .text
